    def test_actual_host_observation_fails_closed_on_transport_and_usage_ambiguity(self):
        from types import SimpleNamespace
        class ReadHost(m.Host):
            endpoint = 'unix:///var/run/docker.sock'
            containers = b''
            usage = 0
            foreign_used = False
            def command(self, argv, **kwargs):
                if argv[:3] == ['docker', 'context', 'inspect']:
                    value = self.endpoint.encode()
                elif argv[:2] == ['docker', 'ps']:
                    value = self.containers
                elif argv[:3] == ['docker', 'volume', 'ls']:
                    value = b'\n'.join(('volume' + str(i)).encode() for i in range(19))
                elif argv[:3] == ['docker', 'network', 'ls']:
                    value = b'\n'.join(('network' + str(i)).encode() for i in range(6))
                elif argv[:5] == ['ctr', '--address', '/run/containerd/containerd.sock', '--namespace', 'moby']:
                    value = b''
                else:
                    raise AssertionError('Unexpected command')
                return SimpleNamespace(stdout=value, returncode=0)
            def read_api(self, path):
                if path.endswith('/info'):
                    return {'DockerRootDir': m.ROOT, 'Driver': 'overlayfs', 'Containerd': {'Address': '/run/containerd/containerd.sock', 'Namespaces': {'Containers': 'moby'}}}
                return [{'Id': USED, 'Containers': 1}, {'Id': IMAGE, 'Containers': 1 if self.foreign_used else self.usage}]
        configs = (((CID, USED, 'private-hash'),), frozenset({'volume0'}))
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=True), patch.object(m, 'metadata', return_value=configs), patch.object(os, 'stat', return_value=SimpleNamespace(st_dev=1)), patch.object(os, 'lstat', return_value=SimpleNamespace(st_mode=m.stat.S_IFSOCK, st_uid=0)):
            self.assertIn(USED, ReadHost().observe()[4])
            for name, value in (('endpoint', 'ssh://untrusted'), ('containers', b'unknown-container'), ('usage', -1), ('usage', None), ('usage', True), ('foreign_used', True)):
                with self.subTest(name=name, value=value):
                    host = ReadHost()
                    setattr(host, name, value)
                    with self.assertRaises(m.RecoveryError):
                        host.observe()
            with patch.dict(os.environ, {'DOCKER_HOST': 'unix:///different.sock'}):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(m.RecoveryError, 'DOCKER_CONTEXT_ENV'):
                    ReadHost().observe()

    def test_actual_containerd_probe_requires_pinned_socket_and_empty_real_stores(self):
        from types import SimpleNamespace as N
        host = m.Host()
        info = {'Containerd': {'Address':'/run/containerd/containerd.sock',
                              'Namespaces':{'Containers':'moby'}}}
        with patch.object(os,'lstat',return_value=N(st_mode=m.stat.S_IFSOCK,st_uid=0)), patch.object(host,'command',return_value=N(returncode=0,stdout=b'')) as call:
            host.observe_empty_containerd(info)
            self.assertEqual([x.args[0] for x in call.call_args_list], [
                ['ctr','--address','/run/containerd/containerd.sock','--namespace','moby','containers','list','--quiet'],
                ['ctr','--address','/run/containerd/containerd.sock','--namespace','moby','tasks','list','--quiet']])
            for value in ({}, {'Containerd':{'Address':'/untrusted.sock','Namespaces':{'Containers':'moby'}}},
                          {'Containerd':{'Address':'/run/containerd/containerd.sock','Namespaces':{'Containers':'unknown'}}}):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(m.RecoveryError,'CONTAINERD_ENDPOINT_UNKNOWN'):
                    host.observe_empty_containerd(value)
            for value in (N(st_mode=m.stat.S_IFREG,st_uid=0), N(st_mode=m.stat.S_IFSOCK,st_uid=1000)):
                with patch.object(os,'lstat',return_value=value), self.assertRaisesRegex(m.RecoveryError,'CONTAINERD_SOCKET_IDENTITY'):
                    host.observe_empty_containerd(info)
            with patch.object(os,'lstat',side_effect=FileNotFoundError()), self.assertRaisesRegex(m.RecoveryError,'CONTAINERD_SOCKET_UNAVAILABLE'):
                host.observe_empty_containerd(info)
            with patch.object(host,'command',side_effect=FileNotFoundError()), self.assertRaisesRegex(m.RecoveryError,'CONTAINERD_PROBE_UNAVAILABLE'):
                host.observe_empty_containerd(info)
            for values, code in (([N(returncode=1,stdout=b'')],'CONTAINERD_INVENTORY_UNAVAILABLE'),
                                  ([N(returncode=0,stdout=b'object')],'CONTAINERD_OBJECTS_PRESENT'),
                                  ([N(returncode=0,stdout=b''),N(returncode=0,stdout=b'task')],'CONTAINERD_OBJECTS_PRESENT')):
                with patch.object(host,'command',side_effect=values), self.assertRaisesRegex(m.RecoveryError,code):
                    host.observe_empty_containerd(info)

    def test_actual_workflow_requires_exact_owner_command_and_successful_contract(self):
        import ast
        import re
        from types import SimpleNamespace as N
        here = Path(__file__).parent
        workflow_path = here / 'production-stopped-runtime-headroom.yml'
        if not workflow_path.exists():
            workflow_path = here.parent / '.github/workflows/production-stopped-runtime-headroom.yml'
        workflow = workflow_path.read_text()
        codes = []
        for job in ('contract', 'recover'):
            block = workflow.split('\n  ' + job + ':\n', 1)[1].split('\n    runs-on:', 1)[0]
            condition = re.search(r'\n    if: >-\n((?:      [^\n]*\n)+)', '\n' + block + '\n')[1]
            condition = ' '.join(line.strip() for line in condition.splitlines()).replace('&&', ' and ').replace('||', ' or ')
            tree = ast.parse(condition, mode='eval')
            allowed = (ast.Expression, ast.BoolOp, ast.And, ast.Or, ast.Compare, ast.Eq, ast.Attribute, ast.Name, ast.Load, ast.Constant)
            self.assertTrue(all(type(node) in allowed for node in ast.walk(tree)))
            codes.append(compile(tree, '<actual owner route>', 'eval'))
        def routed(issue=4637, body='/production reclaim-stopped-runtime current-main', author='owner', actor='owner', triggering='owner', association='OWNER', result='success', event='issue_comment'):
            github = N(event_name=event, repository_owner='owner', actor=actor, triggering_actor=triggering,
                event=N(issue=N(number=issue),comment=N(body=body,author_association=association,user=N(login=author))))
            return tuple(bool(eval(code, {'__builtins__': {}}, {'github':github,'needs':N(contract=N(result=result))})) for code in codes)
        self.assertEqual(routed(), (True, True))
        self.assertEqual(routed(event='pull_request'), (True, False))
        for changes in ({'issue':5469}, {'body':'/production reclaim-docker current-main'}, {'body':'/production reclaim-stopped-runtime current-main\n'}, {'event':'push'}):
            self.assertEqual(routed(**changes), (False, False))
        for changes in ({'author':'other'}, {'actor':'other'}, {'triggering':'other'}, {'association':'COLLABORATOR'}, {'result':'failure'}, {'result':'skipped'}):
            self.assertEqual(routed(**changes), (True, False))
        self.assertNotIn('StrictHostKeyChecking=no', workflow)
        self.assertIn('production-full-stack-exact-sha', workflow)
        self.assertIn('SOURCE_VECTOR_MISMATCH', workflow)

    def test_pull_request_contract_has_no_protected_secret_or_issue_write_binding(self):
        import re
        here = Path(__file__).parent
        workflow_path = here / 'production-stopped-runtime-headroom.yml'
        if not workflow_path.exists():
            workflow_path = here.parent / '.github/workflows/production-stopped-runtime-headroom.yml'
        workflow = workflow_path.read_text()
        references = re.findall(r'(?m)^\s*-\s*uses:\s*(\S+)\s*$', workflow)
        def pinned(reference):
            return re.fullmatch(r'actions/(?:checkout|upload-artifact)@[0-9a-f]{40}', reference) is not None
        self.assertEqual(len(references), 3)
        self.assertTrue(all(pinned(reference) for reference in references))
        for reference in references:
            self.assertFalse(pinned(reference.split('@')[0] + '@v4'))
        global_scope, jobs = workflow.split('\njobs:\n', 1)
        contract, recovery = jobs.split('\n  recover:\n', 1)
        self.assertNotIn('secrets.', global_scope + contract)
        self.assertNotIn('issues: write', global_scope + contract)
        self.assertNotIn('concurrency:', global_scope + contract)
        self.assertIn('    concurrency:\n      group: production-full-stack-exact-sha\n      cancel-in-progress: false', recovery)
        for binding in ('PC_PROD_HOST', 'PC_PROD_SSH_USER', 'PC_PROD_SSH_PORT',
                        'PC_PROD_SSH_KEY', 'PC_PROD_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY', 'VPS_SSH_KEY',
                        'PC_PROD_SSH_HOST_FINGERPRINT'):
            self.assertEqual(recovery.count('secrets.' + binding + ' }'), 1)
        self.assertIn('    permissions:\n      contents: read\n      issues: write', recovery)

    def test_all_shared_production_participants_keep_multiple_pending_operations(self):
        here = Path(__file__).parent
        workflow_dir = here.parent / '.github/workflows'
        if not workflow_dir.is_dir():
            workflow_dir = here.parent / 'pc-crop/.github/workflows'
        workflows = {p.name: p.read_text() for p in workflow_dir.iterdir()
                     if p.suffix in ('.yml', '.yaml')}
        # In the private proposal, overlay the exact future payloads. In source
        # CI these same files already reside in .github/workflows.
        for name in ('production-cold-preservation.yml',
                     'production-stopped-runtime-headroom.yml',
                     'production-docker-headroom-recovery.yml',
                     'production-docker-headroom-owner-push-once.yml'):
            if (here / name).is_file():
                workflows[name] = (here / name).read_text()
        def participants_and_validate(payloads):
            participants = set()
            for name, text in payloads.items():
                lines = text.splitlines()
                for i, line in enumerate(lines):
                    if line.strip() != 'concurrency:':
                        continue
                    indent = len(line) - len(line.lstrip())
                    block = []
                    for child in lines[i + 1:]:
                        if child.strip() and not child.lstrip().startswith('#'):
                            if len(child) - len(child.lstrip()) <= indent:
                                break
                            block.append(child.strip())
                    if 'group: production-full-stack-exact-sha' not in block:
                        continue
                    participants.add(name)
                    if block.count('queue: max') != 1 or block.count('cancel-in-progress: false') != 1:
                        raise ValueError('SHARED_PRODUCTION_PENDING_REPLACEMENT:' + name)
            return participants
        expected = {'production-cold-preservation.yml',
                    'production-full-stack-exact-sha.yml',
                    'production-stopped-runtime-headroom.yml',
                    'production-docker-headroom-recovery.yml',
                    'production-docker-headroom-owner-push-once.yml'}
        self.assertEqual(participants_and_validate(workflows), expected)
        # Exercise the actual prior default-single-pending regression on every
        # participant, rather than merely checking the new workflow in isolation.
        for name in sorted(expected):
            with self.subTest(legacy_default=name):
                broken = dict(workflows)
                broken[name] = broken[name].replace('queue: max', '# default pending replacement')
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'SHARED_PRODUCTION_PENDING_REPLACEMENT'):
                    participants_and_validate(broken)

        import ast

        tree = ast.parse(condition, mode='eval')

                   ast.Attribute, ast.Name, ast.Load, ast.Constant)

    def test_actual_output_validator_retains_unknown_journal_on_broken_transport(self):
        import re
        import subprocess
        import sys
        import textwrap
        here = Path(__file__).parent
        workflow_path = here / 'production-stopped-runtime-headroom.yml'
        if not workflow_path.exists():
            workflow_path = here.parent / '.github/workflows/production-stopped-runtime-headroom.yml'
        workflow = workflow_path.read_text()
        def actual_block(marker):
            match = re.search("<<'" + marker + "'\n(.*?)\n          " + marker + "\n", workflow, re.S)
            self.assertIsNotNone(match)
            return textwrap.dedent(match[1])
        pending, record = actual_block('PY_PENDING'), actual_block('PY_RECORD')
        self.assertLess(workflow.index("<<'PY_PENDING'"), workflow.index('"python3 - --sha'))
        valid = {'schemaVersion':'pc.stopped-runtime-headroom.v1','targetSha':TARGET,
                 'beforeAvailableKb':0,'afterAvailableKb':6*1024*1024,'attemptedImages':1,
                 'deletedImages':1,'refusedImages':0,'passed':True,'targetReached':True,
                 'metadataUnchanged':True,'volumesUnchanged':True,'networksUnchanged':True,
                 'runtimeRestored':False,'volumeDataIntegrity':'NOT_ATTESTED'}
        failed = {'schemaVersion':'pc.stopped-runtime-headroom.v1','passed':False,
                  'errorCode':'CONTAINERD_CONTAINERS_PRESENT','runtimeRestored':False,
                  'mutationOutcome':'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED_IF_STARTED'}
        capacity = {**valid,'afterAvailableKb':0,'passed':False,'targetReached':False}
        cases = [('',255,False), ('UNTRUSTED_SECRET',0,False),
                 (json.dumps({**valid,'injected':'UNTRUSTED_SECRET'}),0,False),
                 (json.dumps(valid),0,True)]
        cases += [(json.dumps(valid),rc,False) for rc in (1,2,124,255)]
        cases += [(json.dumps(failed),rc,rc == 1) for rc in (0,1,2,255)]
        cases += [(json.dumps(capacity),rc,rc == 2) for rc in (0,1,2,255)]
        self.assertIn('"$EVIDENCE_DIR" "$rc" <<\'PY_RECORD\'', workflow)
        for raw, status, accepted in cases:
            with self.subTest(accepted=accepted, ssh_status=status):
                with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as root_name:
                    root = Path(root_name)
                    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-',TARGET,str(root)],input=pending,
                        text=True,capture_output=True)
                    self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0,result.stderr)
                    source = root/'input.txt';source.write_text(raw)
                    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-',str(source),TARGET,str(root),str(status)],
                        input=record,text=True,capture_output=True)
                    body = (root/'issue-record.md').read_text()
                    self.assertNotIn('UNTRUSTED_SECRET',body)
                    if accepted:
                        self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0,result.stderr)
                        self.assertTrue((root/'result.jsonl').is_file())
                    else:
                        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode,0)
                        self.assertIn('`UNKNOWN`',body)
                        self.assertIn('Do not retry',body)
                        self.assertFalse((root/'result.jsonl').exists())

            config = directory / 'config.v2.json'
            value = {'ID': CID, 'Image': USED, 'MountPoints': {}, 'Config': {'Env': ['SECRET']}}
            config.write_text(json.dumps(value))
            with patch.object(m, 'EXPECTED_REFS', ((CID, USED),)):
                paths = (root, directory.parent, directory, config)
                for path in paths:
                    os.utime(path, ns=(1, path.stat().st_mtime_ns))
                records, _ = m.metadata(root_name)
                self.assertEqual(records[0][:2], (CID, USED))
                self.assertNotIn('SECRET', repr(records))
                self.assertTrue(all(path.stat().st_atime_ns == 1 for path in paths))
                config.write_text(json.dumps({**value, 'ID': 'x'}))
                with self.assertRaises(m.RecoveryError):
                    m.metadata(root_name)
                config.unlink()
                target = root / 'target'
                target.write_text(json.dumps(value))
                config.symlink_to(target)
                with self.assertRaises(OSError):
                    m.metadata(root_name)
                config.unlink()
                config.write_text(json.dumps({**value, 'padding': 'x' * (4 * 1024 * 1024)}))
                with self.assertRaises(m.RecoveryError):
                    m.metadata(root_name)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
~~~~

assert.equal(result.status, denied ? 1 : 0, result.stdout + result.stderr);\n+    } finally {\n+      if (oldPath === undefined) delete process.env.PATH;\n+      else process.env.PATH = oldPath;\n+    }\n+  });\n+}\n+\n+test('single-node scope: long denied result decodes every byte across chunks', t => {\n+  const context = singleNodeFixture(t, {\n+    scopes: ['allowed.txt'],\n+    changes: assert.equal(result.status, 1, result.stdout + result.stderr);\n+  assert.ok(Buffer.byteLength(result.stdout) > 15000);\n+});\n+\n+test('single-node scope: truncated raw diff pipe fails closed after Private prospective SOURCE1 candidate. No production admission or independent review verdict.

The sole proposed repository change is an append to `.github/workflows/production-docker-headroom-diagnostic.yml`. The original 191427 bytes remain an exact prefix (Git blob `03dbdc1d5e9a97687ddd7713e896fb3094f0f8a0`, SHA256 `09ae88f0bfcf48b93e5f5dea5302d663d5dd5a709507503701014e4c17d27f5a`). Parsed original jobs are also unchanged. The three reserved parity files were not edited. The full candidate and unified patch are present in this directory; the other files are private assembly/test material, not proposed repository files.

The added contract and observation jobs accept only the exact new issue4637 command `/production inspect-root-filesystem current-main`, owner author/OWNER association and either owner actor+triggering actor or trusted connector app1144995. The contract runs its own fixtures without requiring the old command contract. Fresh comment/repository API provenance is checked again before transport. Current main, checked-out HEAD and the issue-event GITHUB_SHA must agree; a moving main causes rejection. The job uses `pc-crop-registration-lifecycle` concurrency, including `queue: max`, alongside the retained original global concurrency. Coordinated freeze of other operational lanes remains a separate prerequisite owned by ROOT. This candidate does not establish that freeze, a GOV grant, or admission under an accepted guard.

The production invocation is fixed to `python3 -I -B - --collect <40hex-source-target> <64hex-collector-sha>`. The target is the accepted source pin, not a claim about the deployed runtime. Runner verification pins the transported inline bytes by SHA256. No remote probe precedes collection. DNS resolves the configured canonical address, the host key must match the protected fingerprint, and SSH uses strict host checking, batch mode and an explicit private known_hosts file. No default SSH config is loaded. Protected principal, key material and host identity are not report fields.

The no-child-process collector reads root directory metadata through fstat/fstatvfs, `/proc/self/mountinfo` and fixed kernel attributes under canonical `/sys/devices/` targets of `/sys/dev/block/<major>:<minor>`. It does not query Docker or databases and does not read persistent host data files. Report fields contain closed enums, bounded numbers, timestamps and index relationships. Device names, paths, mount source/options, UUIDs, user/environment data and exception text are excluded. A root bind cannot be disproved from mountinfo: the report states `NOT_PROVEN` or `SUBTREE_ROOT_OBSERVED`. Device-mapper, RAID, unknown and unsupported filesystem/block relationships stay `MAPPED_OR_UNSUPPORTED`; the observer selects no growth tool or partition. Sizes, partition start and parent size permit a later reviewer to distinguish the observed filesystem capacity from the block/partition capacity without asserting atomicity or performing an expansion.

Resource boundaries:

- 15-second real-time alarm remains active through reads, parsing, descriptor closure, validation, rendering and stdout write; inclusive monotonic checks reject equality at deadline. No child process exists in the collector.
- At most 262144 returned kernel-read bytes, including any overflow witness. Each file has a separate cap; exhaustion without room for an EOF probe is rejected. At most16 device nodes,8 slaves per node and depth4. Cycles, missing/invalid parents and partition end beyond parent size are rejected. Kernel sectors use512-byte units and signed63-bit byte caps.
- Closed report limit16384 bytes. Only a zero-exit SSH completion and a currently fresh, source/target-bound, strictly validated `OBSERVED` JSON value can reach the new artifact. A partial, malformed, stale, wrong-source, oversized or nonzero report is rejected. Stdout is drained into bounded memory; stderr goes to DEVNULL and is not retained or uploaded.
- SSH transport has an inclusive45-second completion bound followed by a5-second TERM and2-second KILL acknowledgement reserve when necessary. Connection timeout10 seconds; job timeout5 minutes also covers local provenance/key setup. The collector's15-second alarm and runner watchdog cannot prove termination of a process stuck in an uninterruptible kernel wait. Missing completion or cleanup acknowledgement is explicitly `NOT_PROVEN`; the workflow grants no success or replacement report from that case. The outer job timeout is not claimed as proof of guest termination.
- Only the admitted closed observation is uploaded, with3-day retention. Existing legacy artifacts/retention are unchanged. Private runner key/source/output files are removed by an always cleanup step. No new raw log/artifact or external comment is created by the added jobs.

Actual local verification is in `test-results.json` and `local-checks.log`: YAML parse, exact prefix/old-job equality, bash syntax for every retained/new run block, the unchanged legacy first contract,18 actual new route-condition cases, and23 direct tests passed. The direct tests include valid partition/whole-disk data; bind ambiguity; mapper/RAID/unsupported cases; malformed/duplicate roots; wrong identity/parent/overlap; graph/count/slave/depth limits; inclusive deadline and byte limits; path escape; output/freshness/source limits; closed privacy; and execution of the actual inline transport against mocked pipes/processes, including timeout and missing TERM/KILL acknowledgement. One newly added fixture initially omitted an iterable protocol method; that fixture harness was corrected before the recorded final run. No production interface was opened by the new tests.

NOT_RUN: GitHub native execution, actionlint (not installed), production/SSH collection, full repository suite, deployment, independent source review, new-purpose GOV and accepted-guard admission. No source/ref/host/shared-journal/external comment mutation was performed. Private files do not authorize an execution or establish production closure.

+          assert match is not None

+          tree = ast.parse(raw)

+                  names = [x.name for x in node.names] if isinstance(node, ast.Import) else [node.module]
+                  assert not any(x.split('.')[0] in {'subprocess', 'socket', 'ctypes'} for x in names)

+                  f.table[(8, 2)]['slaves'] = [(8, i) for i in range(10, 17)]
+                  v = observed(f)
+                  self.assertEqual(len(v['devices']), 16)
+                  g.validate(v, TARGET, SOURCE)
+                  f.table[(8, 17)] = {'kind': 'unknown', 'size': 200, 'slaves': []}
+                  f.table[(8, 2)]['slaves'].append((8, 17))
+                  with self.assertRaises(g.ClosedError):
+                      g.collect(f)

+              def test_read_exact_boundary_and_plus_one(self):
+                  for length, admitted in ((16, True), (17, False)):
+                      k = g.Kernel()
+                      k.remaining = 17
+                      with patch.object(g.os, 'open', return_value=42), patch.object(g.os, 'close'), \
+                              patch.object(g.os, 'read', side_effect=[b'x' * length, b'']):
+                          if admitted:
+                              self.assertEqual(len(k.read('/proc/self/mountinfo', 16)), 16)
+                          else:
+                              with self.assertRaises(g.ClosedError):
+                                  k.read('/proc/self/mountinfo', 16)
+                  k = g.Kernel()
+                  k.remaining = 16
+                  with patch.object(g.os, 'open', return_value=42), patch.object(g.os, 'close'), \
+                          patch.object(g.os, 'read', return_value=b'x' * 16) as read:
+                      with self.assertRaises(g.ClosedError):
+                          k.read('/proc/self/mountinfo', 16)

+                  k = g.Kernel()
+                  k.remaining = 0
+                  with patch.object(g.os, 'open', return_value=42), patch.object(g.os, 'close'), \
+                          patch.object(g.os, 'read', return_value=b'x'):
+                      with self.assertRaises(g.ClosedError):

+              def test_actual_slave_directory_boundary_plus_one(self):
+                  class Entries:
+                      def __init__(self, count):
+                          self.values = [SimpleNamespace(path='/sys/devices/mock/slave') for _ in range(count)]
+                          self.closed = False
+                      def __enter__(self):

+                      def __iter__(self):
+                          return iter(self.values)

+                          else:

+                      self.assertTrue(entries.closed)

+              def test_deadline_inclusive_and_plus_one(self):

+                      with patch.object(g.time, 'monotonic', return_value=k.started + elapsed):
+                          with self.assertRaises(g.ClosedError):
+                              k.check()

+              def test_alarm_interrupts_userspace_without_child(self):

+                      signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, old)

+                  v = observed()

+              def transport(self, variant):
+                  # Execute the actual inline transport with every process/pipe/clock mocked.
+                  # No SSH binary, socket, or host interface is opened by these fixtures.
+                  import re
+                  workflow = Path('.github/workflows/production-docker-headroom-diagnostic.yml').read_text()
+                  match = re.search(r"^          python3 - <<'PY_GEOMETRY_TRANSPORT'\n(.*?)^          PY_GEOMETRY_TRANSPORT\n", workflow, re.M | re.S)
+                  source_code = Path(g.__file__).read_bytes()
+                  source_sha = hashlib.sha256(source_code).hexdigest()
+                  value = observed()
+                  value['collector_sha256'] = source_sha
+                  if variant == 'stale':
+                      value['observed_at'] = (dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc) - dt.timedelta(seconds=301)).isoformat()
+                  if variant == 'wrong-source':
+                      value['collector_sha256'] = '0' * 64
+                  payload = g.encoded(value)
+                  if variant == 'oversize':
+                      payload = b'x' * (g.OUTPUT_CAP + 1)
+                  if variant == 'invalid-json':
+                      payload = b'NOT_JSON'
+          
+                  class Stream:
+                      def __init__(self, fd):
+                          self.fd, self.closed = fd, False
+                      def fileno(self):
+                          return self.fd
+                      def close(self):
+                          self.closed = True
+          
+                  class Process:
+                      def __init__(self):
+                          self.stdin, self.stdout = Stream(10), Stream(11)
+                          self.pid, self.returncode, self.waits = 12345, None, []
+                      def poll(self):
+                          return self.returncode
+                      def wait(self, timeout):
+                          self.waits.append(timeout)
+                          if variant == 'no-cleanup-ack':
+                              raise subprocess.TimeoutExpired('fixture', timeout)
+                          self.returncode = 255 if variant == 'remote-failure' else 0
+                          return self.returncode
+          
+                  process = Process()
+                  calls, killed = [], []
+          
+                  def popen(args, **kwargs):
+                      calls.append((args, kwargs))
+                      return process
+          
+                  class Mux:
+                      def __init__(self):
+                          self.entries = {}
+                      def register(self, fileobj, events, data):
+                          self.entries[fileobj.fd] = SimpleNamespace(fd=fileobj.fd, fileobj=fileobj, data=data)
+                      def unregister(self, fileobj):
+                          del self.entries[fileobj.fd]
+                      def get_map(self):
+                          return self.entries
+                      def select(self, timeout):
+                          return [(v, 1) for v in list(self.entries.values())]
+                      def close(self):
+                          pass
+          
+                  remaining = bytearray(payload)
+                  def read(fd, amount):
+                      self.assertEqual(fd, 11)
+                      chunk = bytes(remaining[:amount])
+                      del remaining[:amount]
+                      return chunk
+                  def write(fd, raw):
+                      self.assertEqual(fd, 10)
+                      return len(raw)
+                  clock = (iter([0.0, 46.0]) if variant in {'timeout', 'no-cleanup-ack'} else None)
+                  with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+                      Path(directory, 'root-geometry.py').write_bytes(source_code)
+                      env = {'RUNNER_TEMP': directory, 'GEOMETRY_SOURCE_SHA256': source_sha,
+                             'GEOMETRY_TARGET_SHA': TARGET, 'GEOMETRY_PORT': '22',
+                             'SSH_USER_SECRET': 'fixture-principal', 'DEFAULT_HOST': '192.0.2.1'}
+                      with patch.dict(os.environ, env), patch.object(subprocess, 'Popen', side_effect=popen), \
+                              patch.object(selectors, 'DefaultSelector', Mux), patch.object(os, 'set_blocking'), \
+                              patch.object(os, 'read', side_effect=read), patch.object(os, 'write', side_effect=write), \
+                              patch.object(os, 'killpg', side_effect=lambda *args: killed.append(args)), \
+                              patch.object(time, 'monotonic', side_effect=(lambda: next(clock)) if clock else lambda: 0.0):
+                          if variant == 'success':
+                              exec(compile(textwrap.dedent(match[1]), '<actual transport>', 'exec'), {})
+                          else:
+                              with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as error:
+                                  exec(compile(textwrap.dedent(match[1]), '<actual transport>', 'exec'), {})
+                              self.assertEqual(error.exception.code, 1)
+                      exists = Path(directory, 'root-geometry-candidate.json').exists()
+                      self.assertEqual(exists, variant == 'success')
+                  self.assertEqual(len(calls), 1)
+                  args, kwargs = calls[0]
+                  self.assertIn('StrictHostKeyChecking=yes', args)
+                  self.assertIn('python3 -I -B - --collect ' + TARGET + ' ' + source_sha, args)
+                  self.assertIs(kwargs['stderr'], subprocess.DEVNULL)
+                  self.assertTrue(process.stdin.closed and process.stdout.closed)
+                  if variant == 'no-cleanup-ack':
+                      self.assertEqual([s for pid, s in killed], [signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGKILL])
+                      self.assertEqual(process.waits, [5, 2])
+          
+              def test_actual_transport_success(self):
+                  self.transport('success')
+          
+              def test_actual_transport_rejects_output_time_source_and_completion(self):
+                  for variant in ('oversize', 'invalid-json', 'stale', 'wrong-source', 'remote-failure', 'timeout', 'no-cleanup-ack'):
+                      with self.subTest(variant=variant):

+          
+          if __name__ == '__main__':
+              unittest.main(verbosity=2)
+          PY_ROOT_GEOMETRY_FIXTURES

+      - name: Verify fresh exact owner provenance for geometry purpose
+        if: github.event_name == 'issue_comment'
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+          COMMENT_ID: ${{ github.event.comment.id }}
+          EXPECTED_BODY: /production inspect-root-filesystem current-main
+          TRIGGERING_ACTOR: ${{ github.triggering_actor }}
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -Eeuo pipefail
+          [[ "$COMMENT_ID" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
+          owner="$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --jq '.owner.login')"
+          comment="$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/comments/$COMMENT_ID")"
+          [[ "$(jq -r '.user.login' <<< "$comment")" == "$owner" ]]
+          [[ "$(jq -r '.author_association' <<< "$comment")" == OWNER ]]
+          [[ "$(jq -r '.body' <<< "$comment")" == "$EXPECTED_BODY" ]]
+          # jq comparison preserves trailing newlines; shell substitution does not.
+          jq -e --arg body "$EXPECTED_BODY" '.body == $body' <<< "$comment" >/dev/null
+          issue="$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/4637")"
+          jq -e '.state == "open" and (has("pull_request") | not)' <<< "$issue" >/dev/null
+          if [[ "$GITHUB_ACTOR" == "$owner" && "$TRIGGERING_ACTOR" == "$owner" ]]; then
+            echo ROOT_GEOMETRY_OWNER_DIRECT_PROVENANCE_OK=1
+          else
+            [[ "$(jq -r '.performed_via_github_app.id // 0' <<< "$comment")" == 1144995 ]]
+            echo ROOT_GEOMETRY_OWNER_CONNECTOR_PROVENANCE_OK=1
+          fi
+      - name: Resolve exact current main for geometry source
+        id: geometry-target
+        if: github.event_name == 'issue_comment'
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -Eeuo pipefail
+          git fetch --no-tags origin main
+          target="$(git rev-parse origin/main)"
+          [[ "$target" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
+          [[ "$target" == "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" ]]
+          [[ "$target" == "$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/commits/main" --jq .sha)" ]]
+          [[ -z "$(git status --porcelain=v1)" ]]
+          echo "sha=$target" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+  root-geometry:
+    name: Observe root filesystem kernel geometry only
+    needs: geometry-contract
+    if: >-
+      github.event_name == 'issue_comment' &&
+      github.event.issue.number == 4637 &&
+      github.event.comment.user.login == github.repository_owner &&
+      github.event.comment.author_association == 'OWNER' &&
+      ((github.actor == github.repository_owner && github.triggering_actor == github.repository_owner) ||
+       github.event.comment.performed_via_github_app.id == 1144995) &&
+      github.event.comment.body == '/production inspect-root-filesystem current-main' &&
+      needs.geometry-contract.result == 'success'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    concurrency:
+      group: pc-crop-registration-lifecycle
+      cancel-in-progress: false
+      queue: max
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      issues: read
+    env:
+      GEOMETRY_TARGET_SHA: ${{ needs.geometry-contract.outputs.target_sha }}
+      GEOMETRY_SOURCE_SHA256: '4078001f9e60b6a1ff28090f90f71cf3ade4157df85efcb8b16eec15feb15c88'
+      SSH_HOST_SECRET: ${{ secrets.PC_PROD_HOST }}
+      SSH_USER_SECRET: ${{ secrets.PC_PROD_SSH_USER }}
+      SSH_PORT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.PC_PROD_SSH_PORT }}
+      SSH_KEY_PRIMARY: ${{ secrets.PC_PROD_SSH_KEY }}
+      SSH_KEY_SECONDARY: ${{ secrets.PC_PROD_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY }}
+      SSH_KEY_FALLBACK: ${{ secrets.VPS_SSH_KEY }}
+      SSH_HOST_FINGERPRINT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.PC_PROD_SSH_HOST_FINGERPRINT }}
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ needs.geometry-contract.outputs.target_sha }}
+          fetch-depth: 0
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - name: Materialize pinned geometry observer
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -Eeuo pipefail
+          cat > "$RUNNER_TEMP/root-geometry.py" <<'PY_ROOT_GEOMETRY'
+          #!/usr/bin/env python3
+          """Prospective read-only kernel geometry observer; no production admission."""
+          import datetime as dt
+          import json
+          import os
+          from pathlib import Path
+          import re
+          import signal
+          import sys
+          import time
+          
+          DEADLINE = 15.0
+          READ_CAP = 262144
+          OUTPUT_CAP = 16384
+          NODE_CAP = 16
+          SLAVE_CAP = 8
+          DEPTH_CAP = 4
+          MAX = (1 << 63) - 1
+          FS = {'ext4', 'xfs', 'btrfs', 'overlay', 'tmpfs', 'other'}
+          KINDS = {'disk', 'partition', 'dm', 'raid', 'unknown'}
+          REASONS = {'DEADLINE', 'READ_LIMIT', 'OUTPUT_LIMIT', 'KERNEL_IO', 'ROOT_MOUNT',
+                     'ROOT_IDENTITY', 'KERNEL_PATH', 'GEOMETRY', 'GRAPH_LIMIT', 'PRIVILEGE',
+                     'UNEXPECTED'}
+          
+          
+          class ClosedError(Exception):
+              pass
+          
+          
+          def integer(value, minimum=0):
+              if type(value) is not int or not minimum <= value <= MAX:
+                  raise ClosedError('GEOMETRY')
+              return value
+          
+          
+          def number(raw, minimum=0):
+              if not re.fullmatch(rb'[0-9]+\n?', raw):
+                  raise ClosedError('GEOMETRY')
+              return integer(int(raw), minimum)
+          
+          
+          def device(raw):
+              if not re.fullmatch(rb'[0-9]+:[0-9]+\n?', raw):
+                  raise ClosedError('ROOT_IDENTITY')
+              pair = [int(x) for x in raw.strip().split(b':')]
+              if any(x > 1048575 for x in pair):
+                  raise ClosedError('ROOT_IDENTITY')
+              return tuple(pair)
+          
+          
+          class Kernel:
+              """Only fixed proc/sys pseudo-files and metadata on an open root directory."""
+              def __init__(self):
+                  self.remaining = READ_CAP
+                  self.started = time.monotonic()
+          
+              def check(self):
+                  if time.monotonic() - self.started >= DEADLINE:
+                      raise ClosedError('DEADLINE')
+          
+              def read(self, path, cap=65536):
+                  self.check()
+                  path = Path(path)
+                  if str(path) != '/proc/self/mountinfo' and not str(path).startswith('/sys/devices/'):
+                      raise ClosedError('KERNEL_PATH')
+                  fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_CLOEXEC | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
+                  try:
+                      # Every returned byte, including an overflow witness, is inside READ_CAP.
+                      # Exhaustion without room for an EOF probe is unknown, never admitted.
+                      if self.remaining <= 0:
+                          raise ClosedError('READ_LIMIT')
+                      raw = os.read(fd, min(cap + 1, self.remaining))
+                      self.remaining -= len(raw)
+                      if len(raw) > cap or self.remaining <= 0:
+                          raise ClosedError('READ_LIMIT')
+                      extra = os.read(fd, 1)
+                      self.remaining -= len(extra)
+                      if extra:
+                          raise ClosedError('READ_LIMIT')
+                  finally:
+                      os.close(fd)
+                  self.check()
+                  return raw
+          
+              def resolve(self, pair):
+                  self.check()
+                  path = (Path('/sys/dev/block') / ('%d:%d' % pair)).resolve(strict=True)
+                  if not str(path).startswith('/sys/devices/'):
+                      raise ClosedError('KERNEL_PATH')
+                  if device(self.read(path / 'dev', 64)) != pair:
+                      raise ClosedError('ROOT_IDENTITY')
+                  return path
+          
+              def exists(self, path):
+                  self.check()
+                  # lstat observes kernel-created directory/attribute metadata; no file body.
+                  try:
+                      os.lstat(path)
+                      return True
+                  except FileNotFoundError:
+                      return False
+          
+              def slaves(self, path):
+                  self.check()
+                  result = []
+                  try:
+                      entries = os.scandir(path / 'slaves')
+                  except FileNotFoundError:
+                      return result
+                  with entries:
+                      for entry in entries:
+                          if len(result) >= SLAVE_CAP:
+                              raise ClosedError('GRAPH_LIMIT')
+                          resolved = Path(entry.path).resolve(strict=True)
+                          if not str(resolved).startswith('/sys/devices/'):
+                              raise ClosedError('KERNEL_PATH')
+                          result.append(device(self.read(resolved / 'dev', 64)))
+                  return sorted(result)
+          
+              def filesystem(self):
+                  self.check()
+                  fd = os.open('/', os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_CLOEXEC)
+                  try:
+                      fs = os.fstatvfs(fd)
+                      rootdev = os.fstat(fd).st_dev
+                      pair = (os.major(rootdev), os.minor(rootdev))
+                      values = {'total_bytes': integer(fs.f_blocks * fs.f_frsize),
+                                'free_bytes': integer(fs.f_bfree * fs.f_frsize),
+                                'available_bytes': integer(max(0, fs.f_bavail) * fs.f_frsize),
+                                'block_bytes': integer(fs.f_frsize, 1),
+                                'readonly': bool(fs.f_flag & os.ST_RDONLY)}
+                  finally:
+                      os.close(fd)
+                  self.check()
+                  return pair, values
+          
+          
+          def mounts(raw):
+              roots = []
+              saw_proc = saw_sys = False
+              for line in raw.splitlines():
+                  fields = line.split()
+                  try:
+                      sep = fields.index(b'-')
+                  except ValueError:
+                      raise ClosedError('ROOT_MOUNT') from None
+                  if sep < 6 or len(fields) != sep + 4:
+                      raise ClosedError('ROOT_MOUNT')
+                  if fields[4] == b'/proc' and fields[sep + 1] == b'proc':
+                      saw_proc = True
+                  if fields[4] == b'/sys' and fields[sep + 1] == b'sysfs':
+                      saw_sys = True
+                  if fields[4] != b'/':
+                      continue
+                  pair = device(fields[2])
+                  modes = set(fields[5].split(b',')) & {b'ro', b'rw'}
+                  if len(modes) != 1:
+                      raise ClosedError('ROOT_MOUNT')
+                  fstype = fields[sep + 1].decode('ascii', 'strict')
+                  roots.append({'major': pair[0], 'minor': pair[1],
+                                'fs_type': fstype if fstype in FS else 'other',
+                                'mount_mode': next(iter(modes)).decode(),
+                                'bind_state': 'SUBTREE_ROOT_OBSERVED' if fields[3] != b'/' else 'NOT_PROVEN'})
+              if len(roots) != 1 or not saw_proc or not saw_sys:
+                  raise ClosedError('ROOT_MOUNT')
+              return roots[0]
+          
+          
+          def collect(kernel):
+              root = mounts(kernel.read('/proc/self/mountinfo'))
+              pair, fs = kernel.filesystem()
+              if pair != (root['major'], root['minor']):
+                  raise ClosedError('ROOT_IDENTITY')
+              if fs['readonly'] != (root['mount_mode'] == 'ro'):
+                  raise ClosedError('ROOT_MOUNT')
+              root.update(fs)
+              nodes, indexed, active = [], {}, set()
+          
+              def visit(pair, depth):
+                  if depth > DEPTH_CAP or pair in active:
+                      raise ClosedError('GRAPH_LIMIT')
+                  if pair in indexed:
+                      return indexed[pair]
+                  if len(nodes) >= NODE_CAP:
+                      raise ClosedError('GRAPH_LIMIT')
+                  path = kernel.resolve(pair)
+                  index = len(nodes)
+                  indexed[pair] = index
+                  node = {'index': index, 'major': pair[0], 'minor': pair[1], 'kind': 'unknown',
+                          'size_bytes': integer(number(kernel.read(path / 'size', 64)) * 512),
+                          'start_bytes': None, 'partition_number': None, 'parent': None, 'slaves': []}
+                  nodes.append(node)
+                  active.add(pair)
+                  if kernel.exists(path / 'partition'):
+                      node['kind'] = 'partition'
+                      node['partition_number'] = number(kernel.read(path / 'partition', 64), 1)
+                      node['start_bytes'] = integer(number(kernel.read(path / 'start', 64)) * 512)
+                      parent_pair = device(kernel.read(path.parent / 'dev', 64))
+                      parent_index = visit(parent_pair, depth + 1)
+                      parent = nodes[parent_index]
+                      if parent['kind'] != 'disk' or node['start_bytes'] + node['size_bytes'] > parent['size_bytes']:
+                          raise ClosedError('GEOMETRY')
+                      node['parent'] = parent_index
+                  elif kernel.exists(path / 'dm'):
+                      node['kind'] = 'dm'
+                  elif kernel.exists(path / 'md'):
+                      node['kind'] = 'raid'
+                  elif kernel.exists(path / 'device'):
+                      node['kind'] = 'disk'
+                  for slave_pair in kernel.slaves(path):
+                      node['slaves'].append(visit(slave_pair, depth + 1))
+                  if node['kind'] in {'disk', 'partition'} and node['slaves']:
+                      raise ClosedError('GEOMETRY')
+                  active.remove(pair)
+                  return index
+          
+              if root['fs_type'] in {'overlay', 'tmpfs', 'other'}:
+                  topology = 'MAPPED_OR_UNSUPPORTED'
+              else:
+                  try:
+                      visit(pair, 0)
+                  except FileNotFoundError:
+                      # Missing block identity is explicit unsupported, never a guessed device.
+                      nodes = []
+                      topology = 'MAPPED_OR_UNSUPPORTED'
+                  else:
+                      topology = {'disk': 'SIMPLE_WHOLE_DISK', 'partition': 'SIMPLE_PARTITION_WITH_PARENT'}.get(
+                          nodes[0]['kind'], 'MAPPED_OR_UNSUPPORTED')
+              kernel.check()
+              return root, nodes, topology
+          
+          
+          def base(target, source):
+              return {'schema': 'root-filesystem-geometry-v1', 'mode': 'READ_ONLY',
+                      'target_sha': target, 'collector_sha256': source,
+                      'observed_at': dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                      'snapshot': 'NON_ATOMIC_KERNEL_METADATA', 'startup_authorization': 'NOT_GRANTED',
+                      'status': 'NOT_PROVEN', 'reason': None, 'root': None, 'devices': [],
+                      'topology': 'NOT_PROVEN'}
+          
+          
+          def encoded(value):
+              raw = json.dumps(value, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False).encode() + b'\n'
+              if len(raw) > OUTPUT_CAP:
+                  raise ClosedError('OUTPUT_LIMIT')
+              return raw
+          
+          
+          def validate(value, target, source, now=None):
+              expected = set(base(target, source))
+              if type(value) is not dict or set(value) != expected:
+                  raise ValueError('closed top-level schema')
+              if (value['schema'], value['mode'], value['target_sha'], value['collector_sha256'],
+                  value['snapshot'], value['startup_authorization']) != (
+                      'root-filesystem-geometry-v1', 'READ_ONLY', target, source,
+                      'NON_ATOMIC_KERNEL_METADATA', 'NOT_GRANTED'):
+                  raise ValueError('source or target identity')
+              if not re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}', target) or not re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', source):
+                  raise ValueError('identity format')
+              stamp = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(value['observed_at'])
+              now = now or dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
+              if stamp.tzinfo is None or not 0 <= (now - stamp).total_seconds() <= 300:
+                  raise ValueError('freshness')
+              encoded(value)
+              if value['status'] == 'NOT_PROVEN':
+                  if (value['reason'] not in REASONS or value['root'] is not None or
+                          value['devices'] != [] or value['topology'] != 'NOT_PROVEN'):
+                      raise ValueError('failure schema')
+                  return
+              if value['status'] != 'OBSERVED' or value['reason'] is not None:
+                  raise ValueError('status')
+              root = value['root']
+              if type(root) is not dict or set(root) != {'major', 'minor', 'fs_type', 'mount_mode',
+                      'bind_state', 'total_bytes', 'free_bytes', 'available_bytes', 'block_bytes', 'readonly'}:
+                  raise ValueError('root schema')
+              for key in ('major', 'minor', 'total_bytes', 'free_bytes', 'available_bytes'):
+                  integer(root[key])
+              integer(root['block_bytes'], 1)
+              if root['major'] > 1048575 or root['minor'] > 1048575:
+                  raise ValueError('root identity range')
+              if (root['fs_type'] not in FS or root['mount_mode'] not in {'ro', 'rw'} or
+                      root['bind_state'] not in {'NOT_PROVEN', 'SUBTREE_ROOT_OBSERVED'} or
+                      type(root['readonly']) is not bool or root['readonly'] != (root['mount_mode'] == 'ro') or
+                      not root['available_bytes'] <= root['free_bytes'] <= root['total_bytes']):
+                  raise ValueError('root scalars')
+              nodes = value['devices']
+              if type(nodes) is not list or len(nodes) > NODE_CAP:
+                  raise ValueError('nodes')
+              ids = set()
+              for i, node in enumerate(nodes):
+                  if type(node) is not dict or set(node) != {'index', 'major', 'minor', 'kind', 'size_bytes',
+                          'start_bytes', 'partition_number', 'parent', 'slaves'}:
+                      raise ValueError('node schema')
+                  for key in ('index', 'major', 'minor', 'size_bytes'):
+                      integer(node[key])
+                  pair = (node['major'], node['minor'])
+                  if node['index'] != i or pair in ids or any(x > 1048575 for x in pair):
+                      raise ValueError('node identity')
+                  ids.add(pair)
+                  if node['kind'] not in KINDS or type(node['slaves']) is not list or len(node['slaves']) > SLAVE_CAP:
+                      raise ValueError('node kind')
+                  if node['size_bytes'] % 512:
+                      raise ValueError('kernel sector alignment')
+                  refs = node['slaves'] + ([] if node['parent'] is None else [node['parent']])
+                  if any(type(x) is not int or not 0 <= x < len(nodes) or x == i for x in refs) or len(set(refs)) != len(refs):
+                      raise ValueError('node relationships')
+                  if node['kind'] == 'partition':
+                      integer(node['start_bytes'])
+                      integer(node['partition_number'], 1)
+                      if node['start_bytes'] % 512:
+                          raise ValueError('partition sector alignment')
+                      if node['parent'] is None:
+                          raise ValueError('missing parent')
+                      parent = nodes[node['parent']]
+                      if parent['kind'] != 'disk' or node['start_bytes'] + node['size_bytes'] > parent['size_bytes']:
+                          raise ValueError('parent geometry')
+                  elif any(node[x] is not None for x in ('start_bytes', 'partition_number', 'parent')):
+                      raise ValueError('nonpartition parent')
+                  if node['kind'] in {'disk', 'partition'} and node['slaves']:
+                      raise ValueError('simple slaves')
+              seen = set()
+          
+              def walk(index, active, depth):
+                  if index in active or depth > DEPTH_CAP:
+                      raise ValueError('cycle or depth')
+                  seen.add(index)
+                  node = nodes[index]
+                  for ref in node['slaves'] + ([] if node['parent'] is None else [node['parent']]):
+                      walk(ref, active | {index}, depth + 1)
+          
+              if nodes:
+                  if (nodes[0]['major'], nodes[0]['minor']) != (root['major'], root['minor']):
+                      raise ValueError('root relationship')
+                  walk(0, set(), 0)
+                  if seen != set(range(len(nodes))):
+                      raise ValueError('unreachable node')
+              topology = value['topology']
+              if topology not in {'SIMPLE_WHOLE_DISK', 'SIMPLE_PARTITION_WITH_PARENT', 'MAPPED_OR_UNSUPPORTED'}:
+                  raise ValueError('topology')
+              if topology.startswith('SIMPLE_'):
+                  wanted = 'disk' if topology == 'SIMPLE_WHOLE_DISK' else 'partition'
+                  if not nodes or nodes[0]['kind'] != wanted or root['fs_type'] not in {'ext4', 'xfs', 'btrfs'}:
+                      raise ValueError('simple topology')
+                  if root['total_bytes'] > nodes[0]['size_bytes']:
+                      raise ValueError('filesystem exceeds block snapshot')
+              elif nodes and nodes[0]['kind'] in {'disk', 'partition'}:
+                  raise ValueError('unsupported topology inconsistency')
+          
+          
+          def no_duplicates(pairs):
+              result = {}
+              for key, value in pairs:
+                  if key in result:
+                      raise ValueError('duplicate key')
+                  result[key] = value
+              return result
+          
+          
+          def alarm_handler(signum, frame):
+              raise ClosedError('DEADLINE')
+          
+          
+          def main(argv):
+              if len(argv) not in {4, 5} or argv[1] not in {'--collect', '--validate'}:
+                  return 2
+              mode, target, source = argv[1:4]
+              if not re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}', target) or not re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', source):
+                  return 2
+              if mode == '--validate':
+                  if len(argv) != 5:
+                      return 2
+                  with open(argv[4], 'rb') as stream:
+                      raw = stream.read(OUTPUT_CAP + 1)
+                  if len(raw) > OUTPUT_CAP:
+                      return 2
+                  validate(json.loads(raw, object_pairs_hook=no_duplicates), target, source)
+                  return 0
+              if len(argv) != 4:
+                  return 2
+              signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, alarm_handler)
+              signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL, DEADLINE)
+              kernel = Kernel()
+              value = base(target, source)
+              result = 1
+              try:
+                  if os.geteuid() != 0:
+                      raise ClosedError('PRIVILEGE')
+                  root, nodes, topology = collect(kernel)
+                  value.update(status='OBSERVED', root=root, devices=nodes, topology=topology)
+                  kernel.check()
+                  validate(value, target, source)
+                  raw = encoded(value)
+                  kernel.check()
+                  # Alarm remains active through rendering and write. Kernel uninterruptible
+                  # waits still require transport UNKNOWN, never a claimed termination proof.
+                  written = os.write(1, raw)
+                  if written != len(raw):
+                      return 1
+                  kernel.check()
+                  result = 0
+              except BaseException as exc:
+                  reason = str(exc) if isinstance(exc, ClosedError) and str(exc) in REASONS else (
+                      'KERNEL_IO' if isinstance(exc, OSError) else 'UNEXPECTED')
+                  value = base(target, source)
+                  value['reason'] = reason
+                  try:
+                      # No retry after deadline: partial/missing bytes fail runner admission.
+                      kernel.check()
+                      os.write(1, encoded(value))
+                  except BaseException:
+                      pass
+              finally:
+                  signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL, 0)
+              return result
+          
+          
+          if __name__ == '__main__':
+              sys.exit(main(sys.argv))
+          PY_ROOT_GEOMETRY
+          [[ "$(sha256sum "$RUNNER_TEMP/root-geometry.py" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" == "$GEOMETRY_SOURCE_SHA256" ]]
+      - name: Revalidate current main and owner provenance before transport
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+          COMMENT_ID: ${{ github.event.comment.id }}
+          TRIGGERING_ACTOR: ${{ github.triggering_actor }}
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -Eeuo pipefail
+          [[ "$GEOMETRY_TARGET_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
+          [[ "$GEOMETRY_TARGET_SHA" == "$GITHUB_SHA" && "$GEOMETRY_TARGET_SHA" == "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" ]]
+          [[ "$GEOMETRY_TARGET_SHA" == "$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/commits/main" --jq .sha)" ]]
+          [[ -z "$(git status --porcelain=v1)" ]]
+          owner="$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --jq '.owner.login')"
+          comment="$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/comments/$COMMENT_ID")"
+          jq -e --arg owner "$owner" --arg body '/production inspect-root-filesystem current-main' \
+            '.user.login == $owner and .author_association == "OWNER" and .body == $body' <<< "$comment" >/dev/null
+          if [[ "$GITHUB_ACTOR" != "$owner" || "$TRIGGERING_ACTOR" != "$owner" ]]; then
+            jq -e '.performed_via_github_app.id == 1144995' <<< "$comment" >/dev/null
+          fi
+          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/4637" --jq '.state' | grep -Fxq open
+      - name: Resolve pinned SSH identity without a remote probe
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -Eeuo pipefail
+          umask 077
+          private="$RUNNER_TEMP/root-geometry-private"
+          mkdir "$private"
+          trim(){ local v="$1"; v="${v#"${v%%[![:space:]]*}"}"; v="${v%"${v##*[![:space:]]}"}"; printf '%s' "$v"; }
+          host="$(trim "${SSH_HOST_SECRET:-$DEFAULT_HOST}")"
+          port="$(trim "${SSH_PORT_SECRET:-22}")"
+          expected="$(trim "${SSH_HOST_FINGERPRINT_SECRET:-}")"
+          [[ "$host" == "$DEFAULT_HOST" ]]
+          [[ "$SSH_USER_SECRET" =~ ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,31}$ ]]
+          [[ "$port" =~ ^[0-9]{1,5}$ ]] && ((10#$port >= 1 && 10#$port <= 65535))
+          [[ "$expected" =~ ^SHA256:[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$ ]]
+          timeout --kill-after=2s 10s getent ahostsv4 "$LIVE_DOMAIN" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | grep -Fxq "$DEFAULT_HOST"
+          validate_key(){
+            tr -d '\r' < "$1" > "$private/key"
+            chmod 600 "$private/key"
+            timeout --kill-after=2s 5s ssh-keygen -y -P '' -f "$private/key" >/dev/null 2>&1
+          }
+          try_key(){
+            [[ -n "$1" ]] || return 1
+            printf '%s\n' "$1" > "$private/raw"
+            validate_key "$private/raw" && return 0
+            printf '%s' "${1//\\n/$'\n'}" > "$private/raw"
+            validate_key "$private/raw" && return 0
+            printf '%s' "$1" | base64 --decode > "$private/raw" 2>/dev/null && validate_key "$private/raw"
+          }
+          try_key "${SSH_KEY_PRIMARY:-}" || try_key "${SSH_KEY_SECONDARY:-}" || try_key "${SSH_KEY_FALLBACK:-}"
+          timeout --kill-after=2s 12s ssh-keyscan -T 8 -p "$port" "$host" > "$private/scan" 2>/dev/null
+          : > "$private/match"
+          while IFS= read -r line; do
+            fp="$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | ssh-keygen -lf - -E sha256 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}')"
+            [[ "$fp" != "$expected" ]] || printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$private/match"
+          done < "$private/scan"
+          sort -u "$private/match" > "$private/known_hosts"
+          [[ "$(wc -l < "$private/known_hosts")" == 1 ]]
+          rm -f "$private/raw" "$private/scan" "$private/match"
+          echo "GEOMETRY_PORT=$port" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+      - name: Collect one bounded kernel metadata report
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -Eeuo pipefail
+          python3 - <<'PY_GEOMETRY_TRANSPORT'
+          import hashlib, importlib.util, json, os, pathlib, selectors, signal, subprocess, time
+          path = pathlib.Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'], 'root-geometry.py')
+          raw_source = path.read_bytes()
+          source = os.environ['GEOMETRY_SOURCE_SHA256']
+          target = os.environ['GEOMETRY_TARGET_SHA']
+          assert hashlib.sha256(raw_source).hexdigest() == source
+          spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('geometry_validator', path)
+          module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+          spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+          private = pathlib.Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'], 'root-geometry-private')
+          args = ['ssh', '-F', '/dev/null', '-i', str(private / 'key'), '-p', os.environ['GEOMETRY_PORT'],
+                  '-o', 'BatchMode=yes', '-o', 'IdentitiesOnly=yes', '-o', 'StrictHostKeyChecking=yes',
+                  '-o', 'UserKnownHostsFile=' + str(private / 'known_hosts'), '-o', 'ConnectTimeout=10',
+                  '-o', 'ServerAliveInterval=5', '-o', 'ServerAliveCountMax=2',
+                  os.environ['SSH_USER_SECRET'] + '@' + os.environ['DEFAULT_HOST'],
+                  'python3 -I -B - --collect ' + target + ' ' + source]
+          started = time.monotonic()
+          process = subprocess.Popen(args, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                                     stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, start_new_session=True)
+          # Source is <=20KiB; nonblocking stdin prevents an unbounded send wait.
+          os.set_blocking(process.stdin.fileno(), False)
+          os.set_blocking(process.stdout.fileno(), False)
+          mux = selectors.DefaultSelector()
+          mux.register(process.stdin, selectors.EVENT_WRITE, 'input')
+          mux.register(process.stdout, selectors.EVENT_READ, 'output')
+          sent, output, good = 0, bytearray(), False
+          try:
+              while mux.get_map():
+                  remaining = 45.0 - (time.monotonic() - started)
+                  if remaining <= 0:
+                      raise RuntimeError('transport deadline')
+                  for key, events in mux.select(min(remaining, 0.1)):
+                      if key.data == 'input':
+                          count = os.write(key.fd, raw_source[sent:sent + 4096])
+                          sent += count
+                          if sent == len(raw_source):
+                              mux.unregister(key.fileobj)
+                              process.stdin.close()
+                      else:
+                          chunk = os.read(key.fd, min(4096, module.OUTPUT_CAP + 1 - len(output)))
+                          if not chunk:
+                              mux.unregister(key.fileobj)
+                              process.stdout.close()
+                          else:
+                              output.extend(chunk)
+                              if len(output) > module.OUTPUT_CAP:
+                                  raise RuntimeError('transport output cap')
+              code = process.wait(timeout=max(0.001, 45.0 - (time.monotonic() - started)))
+              if time.monotonic() - started >= 45.0:
+                  raise RuntimeError('transport deadline')
+              if code != 0 or sent != len(raw_source):
+                  raise RuntimeError('remote completion not proven')
+              value = json.loads(output, object_pairs_hook=module.no_duplicates)
+              module.validate(value, target, source)
+              if value['status'] != 'OBSERVED':
+                  raise RuntimeError('observation not proven')
+              pathlib.Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'], 'root-geometry-candidate.json').write_bytes(module.encoded(value))
+              good = True
+          except BaseException:
+              print('ROOT_GEOMETRY_NOT_PROVEN; GUEST_TERMINATION=NOT_PROVEN')
+          finally:
+              mux.close()
+              if process.poll() is None:
+                  os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
+                  try:
+                      process.wait(timeout=5)
+                  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+                      os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
+                      try:
+                          process.wait(timeout=2)
+                      except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+                          good = False
+              for stream in (process.stdin, process.stdout):
+                  if not stream.closed:
+                      stream.close()
+          if not good:
+              raise SystemExit(1)
+          print('ROOT_GEOMETRY_CLOSED_OBSERVATION_VALIDATED; STARTUP_AUTHORIZATION=NOT_GRANTED')
+          PY_GEOMETRY_TRANSPORT
+      - name: Admit only fresh current-source closed geometry output
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -Eeuo pipefail
+          [[ "$GEOMETRY_TARGET_SHA" == "$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/commits/main" --jq .sha)" ]]
+          python3 -B "$RUNNER_TEMP/root-geometry.py" --validate "$GEOMETRY_TARGET_SHA" "$GEOMETRY_SOURCE_SHA256" "$RUNNER_TEMP/root-geometry-candidate.json"
+          mkdir -p artifacts/root-filesystem-geometry
+          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/root-geometry-candidate.json" artifacts/root-filesystem-geometry/observation.json
+      - name: Preserve closed geometry observation only
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
+        with:
+          name: root-filesystem-geometry-${{ github.run_id }}
+          path: artifacts/root-filesystem-geometry/observation.json
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 3
+          compression-level: 0
+      - name: Clear runner-only geometry transport
+        if: always()
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          rm -rf "$RUNNER_TEMP/root-geometry-private"
+          rm -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/root-geometry.py" "$RUNNER_TEMP/root-geometry-candidate.json"

> 100) throw new Error('READINESS_CANDIDATE_LIMIT');\n            };\n\n            if (context.eventName === 'workflow_run') {\n              const run = context.payload.workflow_run;\n              if (run?.repository?.id !== context.payload.repository?.id || !sha40(run?.head_sha)) throw new Error('READINESS_RUN_INVALID');\n              if (['Repo automations', 'Local Qwen Independent Review',       : await github.paginate(github.rest.repos.listPullRequestsAssociatedWithCommit, {\n                    owner, repo, commit_sha: run.head_sha, per_page: 100,\n                  });\n              for (const pr of associated) addCandidate(pr.number, pr.head?.sha || '');\n            } else if (context.eventName === 'workflow_dispatch') {\n              if (context.ref !== 'refs/heads/main' || context.actor !== owner) throw new Error('READINESS_MANUAL_AUTHORITY_INVALID');\n              addCandidate(context.payload.inputs?.pr_number);\n            } else if (context.eventName === 'issue_comment') {\n              const comment = context.payload.comment;\n              if (!context.payload.issue?.pull_request || comment?.user?.login !== owner || comment?.author_association !== 'OWNER' || comment?.body !== '/merge-readiness') return;\n              addCandidate(context.payload.issue.number);\n            } else if (context.eventName === 'pull_request_target') {\n              addCandidate(context.payload.pull_request?.number, context.payload.pull_request?.head?.sha);\n            } else {\n              throw new Error('READINESS_EVENT_UNSUPPORTED');\n            }\n\n            let blocked = false;\n            for (const [number, expectedHead] of candidates) {\n              const pr = (await github.rest.pulls.get({ owner, repo, pull_number: number })).data;\n              if (pr.base?.repo?.full_name !== repository || pr.base?.ref !== 'main' || !sha40(pr.head?.sha)) throw new Error('READINESS_PR_INVALID');\n              if (expectedHead && pr.head.sha !== expectedHead) continue;\n              const head = pr.head.sha;\n              // These labels no longer confer review or merge authority.\n              for (const label of ['review-gate-passed', 'review-gate-bootstrap-passed']) {\n                if ((pr.labels || []).some(value => value.name === label)) {\n                  try {\n                    await github.rest.issues.removeLabel({ owner, repo, issue_number: number, name: label });\n                  } catch (error) {\n                    if (error.status !== 404) throw new Error('READINESS_LABEL_INVALIDATION_FAILED');\n                  }\n                }\n              }\n              const check = (await github.rest.checks.create({\n                owner, repo, name: checkName, head_sha: head, status: 'in_progress', details_url: detailsUrl,\n                external_id: `platform-v7.merge-readiness.v1:pr:${number}:head:${head}:run:${context.runId}`,\n                output: { title: 'Engineering readiness evaluation', summary: 'Independent review and a manual exact-SHA merge remain required.' },\n              })).data;\n              await github.rest.repos.createCommitStatus({\n                owner, repo, sha: head, context: statusContext, state: 'pending', target_url: detailsUrl,\n                description: 'Engineering readiness is being evaluated; manual review remains required',\n              });\n\n              let ready = false;\n              try {\n                if (pr.state !== 'open' || pr.draft !== false || pr.auto_merge !== null) throw new Error('READINESS_PR_NOT_MANUAL');\n                const output = execFileSync('node', ['docs/platform-v7/autopilot/verify-pr-review-gate.mjs', '--manual-readiness'], {\n                  encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 600000, maxBuffer: 1024 * 1024,\n                  stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],\n                  env: { ...process.env, REPO: repository, PR_NUMBER: String(number), HEAD_SHA: head, REQUIRE_GREEN_CI: '1' },\n                });\n                const results = output.split(/\\r?\\n/).filter(line => line.startsWith('MERGE_READINESS_RESULT='));\n                if (results.length !== 1) throw new Error('READINESS_RESULT_MISSING');\n                const result = JSON.parse(results[0].slice('MERGE_READINESS_RESULT='.length));\n                if (!result || Array.isArray(result) || Object.keys(result).sort().join(',') !== 'automaticMergeAllowed,head,independentReviewRequired,schemaVersion,status'\n                  || result.schemaVersion !== 'platform-v7.merge-readiness.v1'\n                  || result.status !== 'READY_FOR_MANUAL_REVIEW' || result.head !== head\n                  || result.independentReviewRequired !== true || result.automaticMergeAllowed !== false) {\n                  throw new Error('READINESS_RESULT_INVALID');\n                }\n                const live = (await github.rest.pulls.get({ owner, repo, pull_number: number })).data;\n                ready = live.head?.sha === head && live.state === 'open' && live.draft === false\n                  && live.base?.ref === 'main' && live.base?.repo?.full_name === repository && live.auto_merge === null;\n                if (!ready) core.info(`ENGINEERING_READINESS_DIAGNOSTIC=READINESS_FINAL_STATE_MISMATCH pr=${number} head=${head}`);\n              } catch (error) {\n                // Only fixed diagnostic codes may enter the log; raw errors stay private.\n                const allowedCodes = new Set([\n                  \"AUTOMATIC_MERGE_DISABLED\",\n                  \"GITHUB_API_RESPONSE_INVALID\",\n                  \"GITHUB_API_TRANSPORT_FAILED\",\n                  \"GITHUB_LIST_IDENTITY_INVALID\",\n                  \"GITHUB_LIST_RESPONSE_INVALID\",\n                  \"MERGE_READINESS_CHANGES_REQUESTED\",\n                  \"MERGE_READINESS_CI_ACTIONS_RUN_FETCH_FAILED\",\n                  \"MERGE_READINESS_CI_EVIDENCE_MISSING\",\n                  \"MERGE_READINESS_CI_HEAD_MISMATCH\",\n                  \"MERGE_READINESS_CI_NATIVE_CHECK_PROVENANCE_INVALID\",\n                  \"MERGE_READINESS_CI_NOT_GREEN\",\n                  \"MERGE_READINESS_CI_SNAPSHOT_INVALID\",\n                  \"MERGE_READINESS_EXPECTED_HEAD_INVALID\",\n                  \"MERGE_READINESS_HEAD_MOVED\",\n                  \"MERGE_READINESS_HEAD_MOVED_DURING_VERIFICATION\",\n                  \"MERGE_READINESS_HEAD_REF_INVALID\",\n                  \"MERGE_READINESS_INPUT_FAILED\",\n                  \"MERGE_READINESS_OWNER_AUDIT_MISSING\",\n                  \"MERGE_READINESS_PR_IDENTITY_INVALID\",\n                  \"MERGE_READINESS_PR_INVALID\",\n                  \"MERGE_READINESS_PR_NOT_REVIEWABLE\",\n                  \"MERGE_READINESS_PR_REPOSITORY_MISMATCH\",\n                  \"MERGE_READINESS_REPO_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH\",\n                  \"MERGE_READINESS_REPO_INVALID\",\n                  \"MERGE_READINESS_REVIEW_METADATA_INVALID\",\n                  \"MERGE_READINESS_UNRESOLVED_THREADS\",\n                  \"READINESS_PR_NOT_MANUAL\",\n                  \"READINESS_RESULT_INVALID\",\n                  \"READINESS_RESULT_MISSING\",\n                  \"REVIEW_THREADS_PAGINATION_INVALID\",\n                  \"REVIEW_THREADS_RESPONSE_INVALID\",\n                  \"REVIEW_THREAD_INVALID\",\n                ]);\n                const stderr = typeof error?.stderr === 'string' && error.stderr.length <= 160\n                  ? error.stderr.trim() : '';\n                const message = typeof error?.message === 'string' && error.message.length <= 160\n                  ? error.message : '';\n                const code = allowedCodes.has(stderr) ? stderr\n                  : allowedCodes.has(message) ? message : 'READINESS_EVALUATION_FAILED';\n                core.info(`ENGINEERING_READINESS_DIAGNOSTIC=${code} pr=${number} head=${head}`);\n                ready = false;\n              }\n              const description = ready\n                ? 'Engineering checks ready; independent review and manual merge still required'\n                : 'Engineering readiness blocked; manual merge is not ready';\n              await github.rest.repos.createCommitStatus({\n                owner, repo, sha: head, context: statusContext, state: ready ? 'success' : 'failure',\n                target_url: detailsUrl, description,\n              });\n              await github.rest.checks.update({\n                owner, repo, check_run_id: check.id, status: 'completed', conclusion: ready ? 'success' : 'failure',\n                completed_at: new Date().toISOString(), details_url: detailsUrl,\n                output: {\n                  title: ready ? 'Ready for independent manual review' : 'Engineering readiness blocked',\n                  summary: `PR #${number}; exact head ${head}. ${description}. No independent-review approval or merge authority is issued.`,\n                },\n              });\n              core.info(`ENGINEERING_READINESS=${ready ? 'READY_FOR_MANUAL_REVIEW' : 'BLOCKED'} pr=${number} head=${head}`);\n              blocked ||= !ready;\n            }\n            if (blocked) core.setFailed('Engineering readiness is blocked for at least one exact PR head.');\n"
      }
